extracted.intended_audience: participants in Federal Communications Commission proceedings (petitioners, commenters, applicants, counsel, and other filers)
extracted.subtask_description: Rules and procedural standards in 47 CFR Part 1 governing FCC practice and procedure for rulemaking, petitions, notices, public comments and related pleadings, including form, service, ex parte communications, and filing requirements relevant to notice-and-comment participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petitions for rulemaking (§ 1.401)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petitions for rulemaking (procedures for submitting petitions requesting initiation of rulemaking).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice and availability (§ 1.403)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice and availability (requirements for providing notice to the public and making documents available).

rubrics_metrics.name: Action on petitions (§ 1.407)
rubrics_metrics.description: Action on petitions (how the Commission acts on petitions for rulemaking).

rubrics_metrics.name: Commencement of rulemaking proceedings (§ 1.411)
rubrics_metrics.description: Commencement of rulemaking proceedings (procedures and triggers for opening a rulemaking).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of proposed rulemaking (§ 1.412)
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice of proposed rulemaking (requirements and procedures for issuing an NPRM to solicit public comment).

rubrics_metrics.name: Content of notice (§ 1.413)
rubrics_metrics.description: Content of notice (what must be included in a notice of proposed rulemaking or other rulemaking notices).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments and replies (§ 1.415)
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments and replies (procedures governing submission of public comments and reply comments in rulemaking proceedings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form of comments and replies; number of copies (§ 1.419)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form of comments and replies; number of copies (specifies the required form, formatting, and number of copies for comments and replies).

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional procedures for certain FM/TV allotment amendments (§ 1.420)
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional procedures in proceedings for amendment of the FM or TV Tables of Allotments, or for amendment of certain FM assignments (special procedural requirements applicable to these specific rulemaking subsets).

rubrics_metrics.name: Further notice of rulemaking (§ 1.421)
rubrics_metrics.description: Further notice of rulemaking (standards for issuing an additional or supplemental notice if more public input is required).

rubrics_metrics.name: Oral argument and other proceedings (§ 1.423)
rubrics_metrics.description: Oral argument and other proceedings (when the Commission or presiding officers may call for oral argument or other in-person/remote proceedings in a rulemaking).

rubrics_metrics.name: Commission action (§ 1.425)
rubrics_metrics.description: Commission action (standards and procedures governing the Commission's final or interim actions in rulemaking proceedings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective date of rules (§ 1.427)
rubrics_metrics.description: Effective date of rules (rules governing when adopted rules become effective, including timing and publication requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for reconsideration of final orders in rulemaking proceedings (§ 1.429)
rubrics_metrics.description: Petition for reconsideration of final orders in rulemaking proceedings (procedures and standards for seeking reconsideration of final rulemaking orders).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proceedings on a notice of inquiry (§ 1.430)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proceedings on a notice of inquiry (procedures for NOI proceedings, which solicit information rather than proposed rule text).

rubrics_metrics.name: Informal requests for Commission action (§ 1.41)
rubrics_metrics.description: Informal requests for Commission action (procedures for submitting informal requests outside formal pleadings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications, reports, complaints; cross-reference (§ 1.42)
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications, reports, complaints; cross-reference (general filing categories and cross-references to specific filing rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: Separate pleadings for different requests (§ 1.44)
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate pleadings for different requests (requirement to file separate pleadings when requesting distinct forms of relief).

rubrics_metrics.name: Pleadings; filing periods (§ 1.45)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pleadings; filing periods (deadlines and timing rules for filing pleadings and responses).

rubrics_metrics.name: Motions for extension of time (§ 1.46)
rubrics_metrics.description: Motions for extension of time (standards and procedures for requesting extensions of filing deadlines).

rubrics_metrics.name: Service of documents and proof of service (§ 1.47)
rubrics_metrics.description: Service of documents and proof of service (how filings and documents must be served on parties and how service must be documented).

rubrics_metrics.name: Length of pleadings (§ 1.48)
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of pleadings (limits and rules governing maximum lengths of pleadings where applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specifications as to pleadings and documents (§ 1.49)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifications as to pleadings and documents (formatting, required content, and other specifications for pleadings and supporting documents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specifications as to briefs (§ 1.50)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specifications as to briefs (format and content standards specific to briefs).

rubrics_metrics.name: Number of copies of pleadings, briefs, and other papers (§ 1.51)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of copies of pleadings, briefs, and other papers (how many physical or electronic copies must be filed/provided).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscription and verification (§ 1.52)
rubrics_metrics.description: Subscription and verification (requirements that filings be signed/sworn to and verified as accurate).

rubrics_metrics.name: Informal petitions/forbearance-specific pleadings (§§ 1.53-1.59 overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Forbearance proceedings and related separate pleading rules (special requirements when petitioning for forbearance, including completeness and public notice).

rubrics_metrics.name: Ex parte communications introduction and definitions (§§ 1.1200, 1.1202)
rubrics_metrics.description: Introduction and definitions for ex parte communications (scope, definitions, and overarching principles governing off-the-record communications in Commission proceedings).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sunshine period prohibition (§ 1.1203)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sunshine period prohibition (limitations on communications during the Commission's pre-decisional 'sunshine' period).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exempt ex parte presentations and proceedings (§ 1.1204)
rubrics_metrics.description: Exempt ex parte presentations and proceedings (circumstances in which ex parte communications are exempted from general restrictions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Permit-but-disclose proceedings (§ 1.1206)
rubrics_metrics.description: Permit-but-disclose proceedings (rulemaking category where ex parte presentations are allowed but must be disclosed).

rubrics_metrics.name: Restricted proceedings (§ 1.1208)
rubrics_metrics.description: Restricted proceedings (rulemaking category where ex parte communications are limited or prohibited).

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on solicitation of presentations (§ 1.1210)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibition on solicitation of presentations (rules prohibiting solicitation of ex parte presentations in certain contexts).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures for handling prohibited ex parte presentations (§ 1.1212)
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures for handling prohibited ex parte presentations (how the Commission treats and addresses prohibited communications).

rubrics_metrics.name: Disclosure of information concerning violations of ex parte rules (§ 1.1214)
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclosure of information concerning violations of ex parte rules (how potential violations must be disclosed and documented).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sanctions for ex parte and communication violations (§ 1.1216)
rubrics_metrics.description: Sanctions (potential penalties and remedial actions for violations of ex parte communication rules).
